gloss: bluff, bravado, false show of strength

definitions.gloss: bluff, bravado, false show of strength
definitions.explanation: A display of confidence or strength that is not genuine; pretending to be more capable or confident than one actually is.

examples.japanese: {虚勢|きょせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧
examples.english: to put on a brave front/to bluff

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虚勢|きょせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}っている→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: He's just putting on a brave front.

examples.japanese: {虚勢|きょせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}ら→張る：12583_haru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めれば→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Instead of putting on a brave front, you should just honestly ask for help.

notes:
USAGE: Almost always used in the expression {虚勢|きょせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to put on a brave front, to bluff). Rarely used outside this collocation.

NUANCE: {虚勢|きょせい} implies that the display of strength or confidence is hollow—the person is actually weak, scared, or uncertain but trying to appear otherwise. It can be sympathetic (someone trying to cope) or critical (someone being deceptive).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {虚勢|きょせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to put on a brave front)
- {虚勢|きょせい}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ (just bravado)

RELATED WORDS:
- {強|つよ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧ (pretending to be tough)
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧ (vanity, showing off)
- はったり (bluff, bravado - more casual)
- ⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧ (intimidation)
